verify_detail: 8,918 ms² (population) / ≈61,148 ms² (sample)\n\nNote on methodology: since the available device-control tools don't expose `am start -W`/logcat-level timing, each measurement is the wall-clock delta between issuing the launch command and visually confirming the app's UI was fully rendered — this includes tool round-trip overhead on top of the device's actual process-start time, so treat these as an upper-bound/black-box estimate of true cold start rather than a kernel-level `TotalTime` figure."
